name: anify-gm
description: Run Anify adventures as the GM with Engine-backed D20 checks and remote progress saves.

interface.shortDescription: Run Anify adventures with Engine-backed remote GM saves.
interface.longDescription: Anify-GM frames solo or party adventures, initializes or loads the user's remote campaign progress from Anify Engine MCP, resolves uncertain actions through Engine D20 tools, and writes updated adventure progress back through Engine MCP.
defaultPrompt: 登录 Anify-GM 并继续我的冒险。
从远程存档开启一段 Anify 冒险。
和已引入的角色一起跑 Anify 冒险。
